title: Ethiopian Sausage Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Ethiopian spices, sausage, and a hint of tanginess.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add spices, cumin, and coriander, and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato, red pepper, and stew, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve with injera or crusty bread for a authentic Ethiopian experience.
